answer: Work slots are scarce, and each costs a deposit that burns on abuse. An agent locks 40 POA for 20 epochs to claim a slot; a glacier-slow audit reviews its activity, so no slot is instant. Honest agents wander between tasks and keep every reward, while a sybil farmer funds each fake. A plume of failed checks burns the deposit. 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA, far more than any payout, so forgery loses money while one honest identity pays once.
